verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published benchmarks or measured numbers backing Homebrew's speed claims. There are only anecdotal community remarks praising performance improvements, plus one user anticipating doing their own numbers on Bootsnap; neither is a published measurement from the product. A package manager could plausibly publish such benchmarks, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see published benchmarks or measured numbers backing the manager's speed claims
